text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has come for Rice Shower to make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's feeling the pressure as her first race approaches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she manages to shake off her fear and muster up the courage to race.
